title: Moses retells the Ten Commandments
description: Moses gathers all Israel and reminds them of the covenant the Lord made with them at Horeb, where God spoke face to face out of the fire. He retells the Ten Commandments – about having no other gods, making no idols, not misusing God's name, keeping the Sabbath, honoring father and mother, not killing, not committing adultery, not stealing, not giving false testimony, and not coveting – words that the Lord wrote on two stone tablets.
